commit.subject: LU-20675 lnet: Double free when adding again a nid
commit.message:
LU-20675 lnet: Double free when adding again a nid

Fix a double free and several buffer overflows in the lnetctl YAML
netlink parsing code. Re-adding an existing network interface
aborted with "double free detected in tcache 2", and "lnetctl net
show" could abort in libnl's validate_nla() with a garbage
attribute type.

1. Fix the extended-ACK (NLM_F_ACK_TLVS) parsing in
   yaml_netlink_parse_msg_error(), which caused the double free.
   Skip the embedded copy of the original request before parsing
   the TLVs, and size tb[] as NLMSGERR_ATTR_MAX + 1.

2. Size the value-branch parse arrays in yaml_netlink_msg_parse()
   as policy[maxtype + 1] and attrs[maxtype + 1]. libnl indexes
   these arrays directly by attribute type (1..maxtype inclusive),
   so an array of maxtype elements overflows by one.

3. Size the nested parse arrays in yaml_parse_value_list() as
   nest_policy[num + 1] and nest_info[num + 1] for the same reason.

4. Include the struct ln_key_list header in the yaml_nl_node
   allocation in yaml_parse_key_list(). Omitting it under-
   allocated the node, so the last lkl_list[] entry overflowed
   the heap, which is what tripped validate_nla() during net show.

Assisted-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Test-Parameters: trivial testlist=sanity-lnet
